question: How should oblations be offered into the worshipped fire?
premises: The practitioner is described as eating milk-rice
Offerings are to be made into fire
The fire must be worshipped and the act done according to rule
inference: One who has eaten milk-rice should make oblations according to rule into the worshipped fire.
uncertainties: Whether pāyasānnaḥ specifies diet before the rite or a general condition is not explicit
plain_english: Having eaten milk-rice, one should offer oblations according to rule into the worshipped fire.
